answers.answer: 1) Four players use 3 random Pods; lowest number in A, next in B, alternate, all Locked. 2) Bag: Blank, 4 Larvae, Creeper, Queen, 3 Adults plus one Adult per player (7 Adults here).

1) Filter higher-player-count cards, shuffle Corporate and Personal separately, deal one each. 2) At first Encounter keep one, remove other face down unseen. 3) Eggs are not Intruders and do not trigger it.
1) Discard played Action card plus two additional Action cards. 2) Contamination cannot pay. 3) Choose one OR section.
1) After finishing own round and passing in Fire, take 1 Light Wound. 2) No more normal actions this Phase; may discard any number when passing. 3) Later rounds do not burn them again.

1) Flip unexplored tile, align Item Counter to Exploration number except Nest/Slime, resolve token and remove it to box. 2) Empty destination then gets Noise roll unless Silence/Danger token replaces it. 3) Occupied Room means no Noise roll; Slime changes Silence to Danger.

1) Careful Movement costs 2, replaces Noise roll with chosen connected-Corridor marker and overrides automatic Exploration Silence/Danger. 2) Forbidden in Combat or when all destination corridors have Noise. 3) Closed Door blocks movement; cannot stop in Corridor.

1) Duplicate Noise means Encounter: clear connected Noise incl Technical space; draw token, place matching Intruder, compare token number to triggering hand. 2) Fewer cards means Surprise Attack; equal/more no attack; Contamination counts. 3) Keep non-Blank token outside bag until rule returns it.

1) Danger moves all eligible adjacent Intruders (not in Combat) into Room. 2) If none eligible, place Noise on each connected corridor lacking one. 3) Move is not Encounter. 4) Slime converts Silence to Danger.

1) Encounter Blank restores Noise on all connected corridors, returns Blank, no miniature. 2) If last token in bag, add Adult if available. 3) Development Blank adds an Adult if available, then Blank returns.
1) Both Intruders stay; Closed Door is destroyed simultaneously. 2) Destroyed Door lies down, cannot be closed except Plasma Torch. 3) Noise-triggered appearance is not blocked by Closed Door.

1) Intruder disappears into ducts; discard injuries, return token to bag, remove miniature. 2) Technical-space Noise stays. 3) Characters normally cannot use ducts except Mechanic card/Plans Item; no Doors there.

1) Shoot costs 1, targets Intruder in your Room, spends Ammo, no contamination. 2) Melee costs 1, targets same, draws Contamination onto Action discard. 3) Shoot blank misses cleanly; Melee miss gives Serious Wound. 4) Double hit = 2 injuries Shoot, 1 Melee.

1) Add injury markers, compare current total: Larva dies at 1; Adult draws one blood card and dies if blood ≤ injuries; Queen draws two and dies if sum ≤ injuries. 2) Adult/Queen death places Carcass; Larva none. 3) Queen Retreat arrow substitutes retreat: draw Event and move via its corridor number.

1) Before moving, one attack per Intruder, large first Queen/Breeder/Adult/Larva. 2) Escape attacks target escaper. 3) If dead, Corpse stays in departure Room. 4) Survive: enter neighboring Room, explore, Noise roll if empty.

1) Attack targets fewest Action cards; tie First Player then order. Surprise targets triggerer; Escape targets escaper. 2) Matching Intruder symbol on drawn Attack card hits/effect, mismatch misses. 3) Larva removed and placed on target board; target gains Contamination atop discard. Existing Larva stays and attack does not kill automatically.

1) Dressing suppresses effect but wound still counts; at 3 Serious, any further Wound kills. 2) Third Light clears track and gives Serious. 3) Heal removes Light or Dressed Serious as specified. 4) Death: Corpse and Heavy Objects in Room; Items removed.

1) Canteen/Shower scan hand only, remove non-Infected; infected places Larva (existing Larva kills); Canteen heals Light, Shower clears Slime. 2) Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes Infected and Larva. 3) Then 1 Light Wound, auto-pass, reshuffle all remaining cards including hand; hand empty until next turn.

1) Shoot/Melee uncarried eggs; each Injury destroys one; missed Egg Melee waives Contamination/Wound; successful Egg Melee contamination unresolved. 2) Grenade 2, Molotov 1; fire 1 per step (2 with Vulnerability). 3) Noise after each attempt. 4) No Eggs on Intruder board destroys Nest.

1) Pay 2 cards for Evacuation Section; Pod unlocked/free space, no Intruder/Malfunction; Noise first and Intruder appearance/presence fails entry. 2) Two Characters per Pod, Heavy Objects take no space. 3) After boarding launch or wait/pass; later first round choose keep waiting, launch, or exit free and take full round. Waiting counts for Noise; Intruder appearance returns passengers; second occupant may launch both.

1) Order: Engines, Coordinates, Contamination, Objectives. 2) ≥2 Damaged kills aboard, pods away. 3) Non-Earth kills sleepers; Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. 4) Survivors scan; any infected triggers shuffle/draw four, any Contamination among four kills; Larva triggers four directly. 5) Pod passengers check too.

1) Basic side; shuffle and randomly place Room 2/1 tiles face down; Exploration token on each Room; extras returned unseen. 2) Random Coordinates face down; Destination B; Time green. 3) Engines each Working/Damaged shuffled face down; 5 Eggs and 3 random Weaknesses start Intruder board.

1) Help number assigns Player Number/order. 2) Deal filtered Corporate+Personal before draft; in order draw 2 draft cards, reveal, keep 1 and shuffle other back. 3) Get board, miniature in Hibernatorium, 10-card deck, fully loaded Starting Weapon, 2 inactive horizontal Quest Items. Blue Corpse starts Hibernatorium. Quest Items need condition first.

1) Refill to 5 at Player Phase start; pass First Player left after draw except first turn. 2) Empty deck: shuffle discard into new deck. 3) Discards face up; Contamination joins Action discard; passing may discard any hand cards.

1) Event phase: Time/Self-Destruct, Intruder attacks, Fire damage, Event movement then effect, bag development. 2) Matching-symbol Intruders not in Room with Characters move via corridor indicated by Event; Technical means removed to bag. 3) Empty Event deck reshuffle; Intruder Attack discard likewise reshuffles.

1) Larva removed, Adult added; Creeper removed, Breeder added. 2) Adult returns just before everyone rolls Noise in order, skipping Combat; Encounter may draw it. 3) Breeder same. 4) Queen in occupied Nest is placed and Encounter; otherwise add Egg; return token. 5) Blank adds Adult if available and returns. 6) Turn ends after resolution.

1) Ninth Fire or Malfunction placement causes ship-loss endgame; extra marker to Room already containing one does nothing; removed markers return pool. 2) Hull loss kills aboard including sleepers and Intruders. 3) Fire may be unexplored; Malfunction may not.
1) Malfunction disables Room action and Computer; Search remains usable. 2) Not in Nest, Slime Room, unexplored Room. 3) Engine status unchanged; already-hibernating sleeper unaffected.

1) Normal Items hidden; others see backs/colors; unlimited Inventory; show any used Item. 2) Heavy Items/Objects visible, 2 Hand slots; Heavy Items found by Search need no Pick Up, Objects do. 3) Add Items attach to another item; Duct Tape puts two Heavy Items in one slot, not Objects.
1) Drop free any time during turn: Item lost/discarded, Object stays in Room. 2) Searched Weapon has 1 Ammo; starting Weapon loaded to capacity; never exceed capacity.

1) Match deck to Room color; white lets choose Red/Yellow/Green. 2) Draw 2, keep 1, rejected card face-down bottom of deck. 3) Lower counter by 1, at zero no ordinary Search (except Scavenging). 4) Nest/Slime Room prohibit Search; Specials no search; Blue items not searched.

1) Craft Basic Action costs one Action card plus two matching component Item cards. 2) Result must be available. 3) Can inspect Craft deck anytime. 4) Antidote flame+medical cross; Taser battery/lightning+tool; Flamethrower flame+tool; Molotov flame+fabric.
1) Initiator alone pays Trade Action; all in Room may trade by agreement. 2) Can give free; cannot exchange Ammo. 3) Searched Heavy Item doesn't need separate Pick Up; only Objects do.

1) Corpse, Egg, Carcass correspond to Weakness cards. 2) Object must be in Laboratory for Analyse, not consumed. 3) Revealed benefit applies to all. 4) Anyone can research for Discover Weakness Objective.
1) Room Action costs 2, be present, no Combat or Malfunction. 2) Computer icon itself has no described effect; Malfunction disables Computer. 3) Fire doesn't disable Room Actions or Search.
1) Add 2 Ammo to one Energy Weapon. 2) Not Classic Weapon, not beyond capacity.
1) Emergency Room choose: dress all Serious, heal one dressed Serious, or heal all Light. 2) Dressing suppresses effect only, doesn't remove/count down. 3) Duplicate Serious effects don't stack.
1) Send Signal places Status marker on board Signal space, used for Objectives. 2) Comms Room always aboard.
1) Fire Control chooses any Room, removes Fire if present, Intruders flee in random directions using one Event draw each. 2) Still works without Fire.

1) Generator starts on green; stop removes marker, restart green. 2) Advance with Time. 3) First yellow makes unstoppable, unlocks Pods once; may relock, later yellow no unlock. 4) Skull = explosion. 5) Active sequence during jump means ship destroyed. 6) Character cannot start with sleeper; Coolant Leak can.

1) Any other Yellow Room with no connected Destroyed Doors. 2) Close all its Doors, put Procedure marker. 3) If all remain closed at current Player Phase end, everything dies and Fire removed; opened door cancels.
1) At new turn Cabins occupant with no Intruder draws extra, hand 6. 2) Malfunction disables. 3) Passive, not Room Action.
1) Command Center selects any Room at distance and opens/closes chosen connected Doors. 2) Destroyed Door cannot be closed except Plasma Torch.
1) Engine Control checks all 3 engine status. 2) Cannot change. 3) Malfunctioned Engine Room doesn't block check.
1) Hatch Control flips Pod Locked/Unlocked. 2) Monitoring secretly views unexplored tile and token, replaces them, may lie.
1) Entering Slime Room automatically places Slime; no Action. 2) No Item counter/Malfunction; Slime max 1. 3) Shower removes Slime, not Fire.
1) Cockpit secretly checks Coordinates or sets Destination; may lie about check. 2) Destination is marker's track setting. 3) Cannot set with Intruder there or change after anyone hibernates.

1) Check top Engine token secretly, may lie. 2) Repair/Break inspects both secretly and restacks any order; no prior check or Engine Control Room needed, works with Malfunction. 3) Need not announce repaired state but must announce changed order.

1) Hibernation only on blue Time space. 2) Noise roll; Intruder appearance/presence fails; otherwise remove mini and safely hibernate. 3) Out of play. 4) Later Malfunction doesn't affect sleeper; ship destruction/checks can.

1) Time final red jumps; awake aboard die, Intruders unharmed. 2) Last active Character dies/hibernates/launches: if Self-Destruct active move to final, else Time to final, resolve. 3) Jump while Self-Destruct active means ship destroyed.
1) No direct Character attacks. 2) Indirect harm examples: lock in burning Room, Self-Destruct, Grenade into crew Room.

1) Adult overflow: return all Adults not in Combat to bag and place one in Encounter Room. 2) If all 8 in Combat, summary says unresolved. 3) Intruder moving into unexplored Room doesn't reveal or remove it.

1) Small curled hit injures Larva/Creeper only; larger curved injures Larva/Creeper/Adult only; other targets miss. 2) Melee mirrors these with 2-hit reduced to one and all misses cause Serious Wound. Summary doesn't separately spell out ineligible-symbol Melee outcome.
1) No Larva and all scans non-Infected = no four-card draw and no card removal. 2) Launched Pod passenger still has Objective check.
1) Antidote flame+cross; 2) Taser battery/lightning+tool; 3) Flamethrower flame+tool; 4) Molotov flame+fabric.

1) Combat if Intruder shares Room; Eggs don't count. 2) In/Out Combat Only labels enforce their condition. 3) Unmarked card/Item actions usable either state subject to requirements; 4) Basic allowed Shoot, Melee, Escape movement only; no Room Actions.
1) Player X need only be dead; no personal kill required; hibernation/escape are survival. 2) Only Survivor means no other Character survives. 3) Your own Character must survive regardless.
1) Empty Door supply: move any Door token from elsewhere. 2) Open=no token; Closed=standing; Destroyed=lying. 3) At most one per Corridor; never Technical.
1) First death immediately unlocks every Pod. 2) They may later be relocked; whether later death re-unlocks after reversal is explicitly unresolved.

1) Storage draws 2 from chosen colored Item deck, keeps 1, rejected card to bottom of same deck. 2) Room Action costs 2, requires room/no Combat/no Malfunction; repeatable at zero counter; counter only limits Search Action.

1) Nest Room Action costs 2 cards, takes one Egg from Intruder board, then Noise roll. 2) All taken/destroyed board Eggs means Nest destroyed. 3) Dropped token is ordinary Heavy Object; Pick Up Action needed, does not restore Nest total.
1) Discard One Use Only Item after use, in addition to Action cost/showing it.
1) Launched Pod occupant counts as arriving on Earth. 2) This says nothing about ship destination; Coordinates are separate.
1) Yes, waiting Pod passengers count present in Section for bag-development Noise rolls.
1) Existing Pod occupant may still wait, launch, or exit despite Section Malfunction. 2) It blocks only new Pod entry.
1) One attack per Intruder, larger first Queen/Breeder/Adult/Larva. Summary doesn't give same-size tie order.
1) Yes, remove Event even if its other effect cannot resolve.
1) Adult returns immediately before ordered Noise rolls, skipping Combat. 2) Encounter may draw same token.
1) Normally Closed Door is destroyed by retreating Intruder, which stays. 2) Way of Moving makes affected non-Breeder/non-Queen do nothing at Door.
1) No. Hand Serious Wound doesn't increase Basic Shoot cost; that cost is one card.
1) Vulnerability adds 1 injury per damage instance. 2) Flamethrower double-crosshair yields 3 injuries.
1) Attacking Larva disappears; existing Larva stays. 2) Character gains Contamination, isn't automatically killed.
1) Sleeper takes no Fire wounds. 2) Ship destruction and final checks can still kill.
1) Yes, Coolant Leak may start with sleeper. 2) Character may not start while sleeper present.
1) Dead/discarded Intruder tokens return to unused pool and remain reusable.
1) Fire can go in unexplored Room; Malfunction cannot.
1) From 2 Light Wounds, next converts to 1 Serious and clears Lights; following Light remains. Outcome: one Serious plus one Light.
1) Heavy Objects drop in Room. 2) Item cards removed from game.
1) No; only first yellow unlocks automatically; later yellow does not.
1) Ship destruction fulfills kill-Queen/destroy-Nest requirements as Intruders die. 2) Your Character still must survive and meet Objective.
1) No, empty Trade without intent to change state disallowed. 2) Honest negotiations can end without exchange.
1) Quest activation is Basic Action on card. 2) Forbidden Combat; allowed in Malfunctioning Room.
1) Shoot, Melee, Basic Movement as Escape. 2) Cannot Trade/Craft/Pick up Object. 3) Permitted unmarked Action/Item Actions remain possible; Room actions forbidden.
1) Soldier can use Covering Fire on self alone. 2) Both choose direction, then one Noise roll. 3) Soldier hand used for Surprise comparison.
1) Remove all Ammo, take one Shoot Action. 2) Damage=Shoot result + floor(Ammo/2) + Assault Rifle +1.
1) See Intruder Attack card before choosing. 2) May protect Soldier when another triggers Surprise, but only Soldier benefits; others still affected.
1) Careful Movement replaces automatic token Danger/Silence with chosen Noise placement; Reconnaissance cancels automatic result.
1) Captain cannot Order while personally in Combat. 2) Intercom can make another move from Combat, applying Escape attacks/rules.
1) Motivation with Intercom affects Characters in Computer Rooms and Captain's Room.
1) Ignore Door Exploration token on Technical Corridors entry because exact entering Corridor unknown.
1) No remote interruption: must share Room with acting Character. 2) Passing does not bar Interruption.
1) No automatic pass when hand empties after 2 Actions; pass next round. 2) Extra round can add Fire/Bleeding effect.
1) Rest with no Larva beforehand places only one Larva despite multiple infected scans, so does not kill. 2) Fatal if Larva already present before Rest.
1) Roll Noise in thrower's own Room, not Nest.
1) No; Object must be in Laboratory even if Scientist uses Intranet elsewhere. 2) Analyse keeps Object.
1) Yes, Storage Room Action repeatable with counter zero, normal cost/restrictions. 2) Counter limits Search card only.
1) Two Eggs destroyed per Fire Damage step with Vulnerability to Fire.
1) No, dropped Egg does not restore Nest egg total/hit points.
1) Affected player chooses and discards one Action card from their hand.
1) Yes, Medkit and Bandages can be used on others.
1) Cannot directly reload other's Weapon. 2) Trade Energy Charge; recipient uses it on their own turn.
1) No Larva on Alcohol Infected scan; instead gain new Contamination card.
1) Yes, attaching Extended Magazine/Auto Loader to used or empty Energy Weapon immediately grants Ammo.
1) Crafted Flamethrower starts fully loaded.
1) No; Hand Wound doesn't affect Motion Scanner, a unique reaction not Item Action.

1) Antidote scans hand/deck/discard; removes Infected, gives new Contamination, reshuffles new+non-Infected+Action cards except hand cards retained. 2) Then pass; may keep hand. 3) Surgery removes infected/Larva, costs 1 Light Wound, auto-passes and shuffles entire hand and rest into deck; no new card.
1) Slime marker on Character; Fire/Malfunction in Room; Door in entry Corridor. 2) Technical entry ignores Door token as exact corridor unknown.
1) One Injury per Intruder in Fire Room during Event Fire step, after attacks and before Event. 2) Summary doesn't expressly say whether this step triggers Injury Effect check.
1) No; Nest and Room Covered With Slime explicitly prohibit Search.
